meta.source: GRAND_PLAN §6 Difficulty + §7 Economy & Balance — single source for tuning; designers edit here without code changes
meta.note: All formulas below are authoritative; game.gd / military.gd fall back to hardcoded defaults if file missing

seasonal_yield._formula: chain_prod_eff = (base_prod + building_prod) * seasonal_mult * difficulty_prod * tech_mult; flour limited by grain_ratio, food limited by flour_ratio

production._formula: prod[key] = Σ(workers_on_chain × productivity × tech_mult × land_quality) − decay  — implemented as (base_prod + building_prod) * difficulty_prod * tech_mult * seasonal_mult

happiness._formula_current: pop_happiness = clamp(0.4 + 0.4*(surplus/50 + 0.5), 0, 1) + tech_happiness_add; if food_stock<=0 then -0.05 and shortage event

population._formula_K: K = carrying_capacity(food_supply, housing, jobs) — implemented as pop_capacity_base(territory) + building_cap.housing + tech_cap_add.housing
population._formula_dP: dP = P * r * (1 - P/K) - deaths(plague, war) ± net_migration(loyalty, neighbors);  r = base_birth_rate * (happiness - 0.4)

revolt_risk._formula: P(revolt) = clamp((1 - happiness - loyalty) * 0.5 + tax_excess + famine_turns * 0.1, 0, 0.9)

battle_power._formula_power: power = Σ(count × strength × morale × terrain_mult × commander_trait × exp_mult × supply × speed_factor)
battle_power._formula_result: result = weighted_random(power_a : power_b) × flanking_bonus × supply_factor; casualty_rate = clamp(0.15 + 0.1*(1/max(ratio,0.5)), 0.05, 0.45)

military_upkeep._formula: upkeep[key] = Σ(count * upkeep_per_unit[key]) * season_mult; shortage -> morale -0.07 supply -0.12

difficulty._note: event_severity/rival_aggression/plague_frequency/willpower are design-facing; production_multiplier/consumption_multiplier are CE tuning derived to match same intent (fallback if absent, code uses production_multiplier etc)

tech._formula: tech_mult[key] = Π(unlocked prod_mult[key]); cap_add = Σ(cap_add); happiness_add = Σ(happiness_add); military_power_mult = Π(military_power_mult)

event_roll._formula: per turn: roll weighted by state (food<20 -> plague x3); base_chance * difficulty_mult
